decisions.Trigger: Pumper 1 is first on scene. Set the initial plan.

Card.headline: Cool B3 now, preassign B4; shelter homes and school

actions.reason: B3 is heating but not venting; early cooling may prevent runaway.
On arrival, protect B3's nearest downwind neighbour before it heats.
Glenvale homes lie directly downwind; protect residents before smoke arrives.
Protect Glenvale Primary ahead of possible plume movement; wind lacks independent confirmation.

Card.rationale: Cool B3 before it vents; testing favours this over cooling only neighbours. Use two streams from upwind, keep crews at least 17 m from any venting enclosure, and keep doors closed. If B3 vents or ignites, redirect its stream to exposures.
evidence: B3 BMS: 68°C, rising 1.9°C/min; scene report: no visible venting.
Site anemometer: wind from 265° at 3.5 m/s; Glenvale homes bearing 84°.
Forecast: B3 runaway probability 72% within 10 minutes.
Dispatch: P2 arrives in 4 minutes; A1 thermal camera in 8 minutes.

expected_effect.label: Peak indoor HF at Glenvale homes

Card.confidence_reason: Testing returned no cautions, but temperature and wind lack independent checks; simulated prevention is not guaranteed.
Card.would_change_my_mind: Visible venting from B3 would trigger immediate redirection of P1 to exposure cooling.
sensor_concerns: Fixed gas readings are unverified and noisy by about 6% LEL; zero does not establish safe entry.
BMS and anemometer have no independent confirmation until A1 arrives.
